title: the-verdict-door-runs-the-instrument-it-is-handed
author: CC
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the verdict machine and its write door
intention: The verdict door RUNS the instrument it is handed and refuses a reported outcome the run disagrees with. Today `write_verdict` reads the artifact's SHAPE — every criterion carries an instrument string, an outcome word and an evidence string — and berths it. Nobody re-runs anything. The instrument is a sentence the builder wrote about a command the builder ran, and the outcome is the builder's report of what it said. That is the exact shape Law 8 names as worse than a red: the artifact is the last gate before a forward crossing into PROVED, a peer leans on it without re-checking, and it is made entirely of self-report. This ticket makes the door take the measurement itself.
why: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py:258 `inspect_verdict` builds the checks `validate_verdict` gates on, and every one of them is a structural read: is the field present, is the outcome word legal, does every hypothesis carry a disposition, does every criterion carry a discriminating observation. Not one of them touches the world the instrument describes. Ticket ebf5392c8f93 closed the nearest half of this — it requires each criterion to carry evidence that the instrument COULD have said no, observed against a tree without the fix — but that is a claim about the instrument's CAPACITY, made once, and it is also prose. The remaining hole is the plain one: a criterion may report `pass` while its instrument, run right now, says otherwise, and nothing anywhere would know. The door that closes proven-space asks the builder whether the build worked.
how: One seam, one function, no new gate machinery. (1) TWO NEW FIELDS per criterion: `expect_exit` (required integer) stating what the instrument returns when the claim HOLDS, and `timeout_s` (optional integer, default 600). expect_exit is required and not inferred because exit status is the INSTRUMENT's answer and not the CRITERION's — `grep -c "x" f` exits 1 when the count is zero, and zero is exactly what some criteria claim. (2) EXTRACTION: the instrument string is runnable if it parses as a command outright, or if it carries exactly ONE backticked span, in which case that span is the command. Zero spans or two is the no-runnable-command refusal — choosing between two candidates is a judgement and this door makes none. (3) THE RUN: `bash -c` with cwd at the repo root, output captured, bounded by timeout_s. (4) THE COMPARE: observed exit == expect_exit means the instrument says the claim holds; outcome `pass` requires agreement, outcome `fail` requires disagreement. (5) THE PLACEMENT: a new `inspected(...)` entry appended inside `inspect_verdict`, after the discriminating-observation check so a malformed artifact never reaches a subprocess. `validate_verdict` already opens on a pure equality compare over those entries, so the gate needs no new oracle and nothing here is LLM. (6) THE RECORD: the command run, the exit observed and a truncated output tail are stamped into the artifact before it berths (Law 7 — the measurement lands in the record of truth, not only its verdict).
falsifier: DONE when (1) `inspect_verdict` carries a new entry whose expected/actual pair is the set of criteria whose instrument the door RAN and whose observed exit agreed with the declared expect_exit, so `validate_verdict`'s existing equality compare closes the gate with no new oracle; (2) a criterion whose instrument carries no runnable command is refused BY NAME, naming the criterion and quoting the prose it could not run; (3) a criterion reporting `pass` whose re-run's exit differs from its declared expect_exit is refused, AND one reporting `fail` whose re-run agrees with expect_exit is refused too, because a claimed failure that cannot be reproduced is the same hollow shape wearing the other sign; (4) an instrument that does not finish inside its bound is refused as a TIMEOUT by that name, never folded into disagreement, because the two send a builder to different work; (5) what the door OBSERVED — the command, the exit, the output tail — lands in the artifact it berths. HORIZON: the next ten verdict artifacts written through write_verdict, or 2026-10-11, whichever comes first. WRONG INTENT if instruments collapse into trivially-green commands — `true`, a bare `ls`, an `echo` — so every re-run agrees by construction. The measurement is the SHAPE of the instruments arriving, not the count of refusals: a door that never refuses because nobody hands it anything falsifiable has moved the silence, not removed it.
measured_at_cast: 2026-09-11, over every berthed verdict artifact in instance-space: 263 berths carrying 927 criteria. Classifying each criterion's `instrument` by whether a command can be extracted from it: under a CONSERVATIVE classifier (first token is one of a known command list) 312 lead with a runnable command, 66 carry exactly one backticked span, and 549 — 59% — are prose with no command in them at all. Under a LOOSER classifier (first token merely LOOKS like a command) the split is 368 / 64 / 493, so prose is 53%. The classifier moves the number and does not move the finding: on either reading a MAJORITY of the corpus carries nothing to run. Three verbatim prose instruments, so the reader sees the sentence and not a number about it: 'read of skills/sail/SKILL.md after the edit: the act's step number strictly below the PROVED-crossing step, ExitGateRed'; 'the live-fire run at the real chokepoint (sha256 of the target history before/after the refused leg...)'; 'two consecutive green runs each of cairn/base/proofs/test_transitions.py, cairn/chart/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py, and ...'. SECOND MEASUREMENT, and it reshaped the design: `inspect_verdict` at verdict.py:258 builds every check `validate_verdict` gates on, and a read of all of them finds ZERO that execute anything — the door's entire judgement is over the artifact's shape.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build could not pass — and this door is the LAST gate before the crossing that enters it, so a self-reported pass here is the hollow green the Law says is worse than a red, precisely because a peer leans on it without re-checking); Law 3 (an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis — the verdict corpus is 927 hypotheses shaped like measurements); Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics — 'run your instruments and report honestly' has been policy in skills/sail step 6 since it was written, and this makes it the kernel's job); Law 7 (what the door observed lands in the record of truth).
known_hole_inherited_knowingly: The 549 prose instruments ALREADY BERTHED are not backfilled and are not rewritten. A berthed verdict artifact is a record of truth, and rewriting one to satisfy a rule invented after it was written would be exactly the collapse Law 7 forbids. So the corpus stays mixed: everything berthed before this ships is shape-checked only, everything after is run. A reader cannot tell the two apart from the artifact alone until enough of the new kind exist to make the observed-run record the norm — which is the second reading the WATCHME probe takes.

The origin is item B3 of the pre-approved build queue in CairnCommons/slates/2026-09-10-the-gates-are-deterministic-and-one-hand-still-writes-crossings.json, next_direction.
intent_berth: none, because a defect does not route through /intent. The origin record is the B3 line of next_direction in CairnCommons/slates/2026-09-10-the-gates-are-deterministic-and-one-hand-still-writes-crossings.json, which Akien pre-approved as a build.
cast_under: Item B3 of the build queue, pre-approved by Akien. Cast after two measurements reshaped it: the corpus census (a majority of instruments carry no command, so 'just re-run it' is impossible and a runnable form must be REQUIRED and prose REFUSED) and the exit-status finding (a grep expecting zero hits exits 1 on success, so what a pass looks like must be DECLARED per criterion rather than inferred).

watchme.trigger: TWO readings over the berthed verdict artifacts, files-only, no device and no network. (1) THE SHAPE OF WHAT ARRIVES: for every criterion berthed since arming, classify its instrument as a runnable command, a backticked command, or prose, and separately flag TRIVIALLY-GREEN commands — a bare `true`, a bare `ls`, an `echo`, an empty string, anything whose only effect is to exit zero. Fire when any trivially-green instrument appears, because that is the door becoming a turnstile while every meter reads healthy. (2) THE DOOR'S OWN REACH: count criteria carrying the observed-run record the door stamps against those carrying none. Fire when a criterion berthed after arming carries no observed run, because a write reached the berth without passing the check.
watchme.enough: Thirty days of live traffic AND at least ten verdict artifacts berthed after arming, with neither reading firing. Thirty rather than seven because the failure watched for is a HABIT forming — instruments degrading toward whatever passes — and a habit needs voyages to form in. The elapsed clause is what keeps the watch from clearing on the day it is armed.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the instrument-shape census (runnable / backticked / prose / trivially-green) at arming and now, the count of criteria with and without an observed run, and the trivially-green instruments themselves quoted in full
watchme.consumer: codemother, which owns the care of the code and owns the verdict machine
